releaseTitle: DocuEdit Pro v10.8.4 (Flawless Sans-Serif Arial & Line-Neighbor Match)
changelog:
⚡ Flawless Arial / Sans-Serif Typography & 100% Line Matching:
• Fixed False-Positive Serif Detection: Arial with natural stroke contrast no longer misclassified as Times New Roman.
• Robust Line Neighbor Clustering: Combines vertical bounding box overlap and rotation-tolerant distance so words on the same line ('For Archana' -> 'Kumar') always share identical font family and bold weight.
• Instant Sans-Serif Consensus: Signature lines, invoice details, and table headers correctly default to Bold Arial.
• Crisp Ink & Optical Alignment: Solid pure black ink with zero camera blur on clean computer prints.
